Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GAIL Medical Consultant - Part-Time Visiting Consultant (Pediatrician) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required. Download the prescribed Application Form from the "Careers" section of GAIL's website: www.gailonline.com. Submit the duly filled-in and signed application form along with self-attested photocopies of all relevant testimonials/documents, updated Resume/CV and two recent colour passport-size photographs prior to the Walk-In Interview on 24.08.2026 at GAIL Hospital, Vijaipur, District-Guna, Madhya Pradesh – 473 112. Hard copy of the application form along with the requisite testimonials are to be physically submitted at the venue on the 24.08.2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for GAIL Medical Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the GAIL Medical Consultant - Part-Time Visiting Consultant (Pediatrician) position is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates must ensure they attend on this date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Pediatrician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Pediatrics (DCH), preferably an MD/DNB (Pediatrics), from a recognized University/Institution. A valid registration with the Medical Council is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary structure for the Medical Consultant position?
faq.answer: The consultation charges are Rs. 3,500/- per hour for those with MD/DNB and Rs. 2,500/- per hour for those with DCH. Additionally, local conveyance charges of Rs. 14/- per km will be provided.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the GAIL Medical Consultant position?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to download the application form from the GAIL website, fill it out, and submit it along with self-attested photocopies of relevant documents at the interview venue on the specified date.

faq.question: Q5. Where is the walk-in interview for the GAIL Medical Consultant post being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at GAIL Hospital, Vijaipur, District-Guna, Madhya Pradesh – 473 112.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies of all relevant testimonials, including educational certificates, registration certificates, updated Resume/CV, and identity proof.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the employment for this post?
faq.answer: The Medical Consultant - Part-Time Visiting Consultant (Pediatrician) position is on a temporary tenure basis.
